intervals.quote: In 2019 and 2020 we successfully performed a measurement of the beta spectrum with the aim to strongly improve the limits on the Fierz interfernce term b using an unpolarised, pulsed neutron beam.

physics_goals.quote: Perkeo III is an instrument to perform precision experiments on the weak interaction.
physics_goals.value: Perform precision experiments on the weak interaction by measuring neutron decay correlations with a pulsed cold neutron beam

summary.plain: A spectrometer at the Institut Laue-Langevin that studies how free neutrons decay, using a pulsed beam of cold neutrons. Its beta-asymmetry measurement gave the neutron’s weak axial coupling constant, a key number in the Standard Model.
summary.technical: PERKEO III at the PF1B cold-neutron beamline: magnetic transport of decay electrons and protons to two detectors with almost 4pi acceptance, pulsed polarized beam; lambda = g_A/g_V = -1.27641(45)stat(33)sys (2019) and a Fierz term limit b = 0.017(21). Runs 2007, 2008/09, 2014/15 and 2019/20 per the TUM group page.
